threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of just 'the train.' Locals know it's a whole vibe, not just a commute.
Last night on the 133, a guy got on with a full saxophone and played ‘Careless Whisper’ while everyone pretended not to listen. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I saw a toddler playing in the street while their parents bartered with a döner guy—only in Neukölln do life and street food blend so perfectly.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club that doubles as a former water pumping station, complete with rusty pipes and an underground vibe. Feels like a secret!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can effortlessly name all the taco trucks that make it through the late-night fog without a GPS.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Heard a bus driver call out a passenger for trying to sneak through the back. 'This isn’t a ninja movie!' It turned the whole bus into a giggling mess.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the street performers are artists. Most are just trying to fund their next paella fix. The real talent hangs out in the back alleys.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their wide-eyed wonder at the late-night tapas bars, still oblivious to the locals' laid-back, almost tepid enthusiasm.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie when they still look confused by the Clapton Pond bus stop. Regulars glide through like they've got a secret.
Last night on the 196, a guy serenaded the whole bus with off-key Whitney. Somehow, it turned into a singalong. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I truly belonged when I saw a group of kids using a broken shopping cart as a makeshift go-kart in the park. Only here!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab shop with a techno DJ spinning vinyl at 4 AM, mixing authentic late-night snacks with beats for the true Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to check BART delays on Fridays before heading out. The train’s an oven by 5 PM, and the Civic Center’s like a no man’s land post-evacuation.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy serenade passengers on the 19 Polk this morning—full on guitar. Everyone was annoyed until he hit the high note. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and plazas, but they miss how every street corner has a different sound—live music, chatter, and laughter blend into our daily life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they keep asking for directions to the nearest 'Mercat' instead of just looking up a 'supermercat'.
